products.description:
Colmar, France Cross Stitch Pattern PDF is a downloadable digital counted cross-stitch pattern from Drielo's Iconic Destinations collection.

The artwork uses an exact 100 × 120 source grid: one image pixel equals one full cross stitch, so the chart does not reinterpret or distort the design.

Pattern details

  • Code: D0040-CS
  • Grid: 100 × 120 stitches
  • Total stitches: 12,000
  • Colours: 45 DMC colours selected for this design
  • Technique: Full cross stitch
  • Skill level: Intermediate

What you receive

Printable PDF with finished preview, DMC key, colour and symbol charts, four enlarged chart sections and working guide.

Digital product only. Personal use only.

Patrón PDF de punto de cruz: Colmar, Francia es un patrón digital descargable de la colección Destinos icónicos.

El diseño utiliza una cuadrícula fuente exacta de 100 × 120: cada píxel equivale a una puntada completa, sin reinterpretar ni deformar la imagen.

Detalles

  • Código: D0040-CS

Producto digital. Solo para uso personal.
